shared_elements: procession/row of figures facing the same direction
figures holding objects in outstretched hands
low relief carving with incised surface detail
winged/disc-like element (sun disc in B, none in A)
justification: Both surfaces show low-relief profile human figures arranged in a row along a horizontal register, with hands extended holding or presenting objects, a fairly generic processional convention. The dominant difference is that A is entirely a large-scale figural procession of bearded, robed attendants approaching a seated/standing dignitary, while B is overwhelmingly a dense field of small script signs with only a tiny figural lunette containing a winged disc, so the compositional purpose and content differ fundamentally.
